title: LLM-Guided Contextual Action Evaluation for Operational Decisions in Industrial Processes
abstract: arXiv:2608.24156v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Industrial actor--critic methods usually represent continuous actions as anonymous numerical coordinates. They must therefore learn from limited interactions which process variables each action affects, in which direction, and after what delay. Fixed industrial documents already describe part of these relations, but their open-text statements neither represent the current operating condition nor directly fit a numerical policy. This article presents LLM-Guided Contextual Action Evaluation for Operational Decisions in Industrial Processes (LCAE), which uses a large language model before training to normalize fixed documents into a frozen action--observation--direction--delay relation basis. Recent numerical action--response history then modulates the current strength of each relation, while the evaluated action forms a state-conditioned nonlinear action-effect field in the same basis. translated_title: 面向工业过程运营决策的大语言模型引导情境化动作评估
translated_abstract: 工业中的演员-评论家方法通常将连续动作表示为匿名的数值坐标。因此，它们必须从有限的交互中学习每个动作影响哪些过程变量、影响方向以及延迟时间。固定的工业文档已经描述了这些关系的一部分，但其开放文本语句既不表示当前运行条件，也不直接适合数值策略。本文提出了面向工业过程运营决策的大语言模型引导情境化动作评估（LCAE），该方法在训练前使用大语言模型将固定文档规范化为一组冻结的动作-观测-方向-延迟关系基础。最近的数值动作-响应历史随后调节每个关系的当前强度，而评估的动作在相同基础上形成状态条件化的非线性动作效应场。评论家通过该场评估动作，并...
tldr: LCAE 利用大语言模型将工业文档转化为结构化关系基础，结合历史交互动态调节，形成状态条件化动作效应场，以提升工业过程决策中的动作评估准确性。
en_tdlr: LCAE leverages large language models to convert industrial documents into a structured relational basis, dynamically modulated by historical interactions, to form a state-conditioned action-effect field for improved action evaluation in industrial process decisions.
